chunks.text:
[Intro]
{a breathy flute trill like a kettle whistling, over a walking bass and brushes that are already strolling}
positive_styles: 16-bit console RPG soundtrack from the mid-1990s
retro sampled-chip instruments with the warm echo of a 16-bit sound chip
breathy flute lead that scoops up into its long notes
cosy theatre interval bar, gentle and funny
strong singable melody, instantly hummable and pleasant on repeat
